findings.text: The every-Hadamard-state limit is this claim's own derived result, not A.3's. The recorded P8-A.3 statement supplies only the reference-state value 'E_ref=hbar/(5120*pi^2*t^4)' and explicitly leaves 'full P8(a)' open; FORMULATION.md presents 'lim_(t -> 0+) t^4*E_omega(t,x) = hbar/(5120*pi^2)' under the heading 'Derived statement', built from this checkpoint's O(eta^-6) remainder plus the A.3 coefficient; the certificate's verification_boundary says the absolute reference EED is 'imported' via hash-pinned A.3 replay. The bound statement text misassigns provenance of its central limit for arbitrary states, conflicting with the evidence's own division of labor. [Statement clause 'A.3 gives lim t^4*E_omega=hbar/(5120*pi^2)>0' vs P8-A.3 dependency statement, FORMULATION.md 'Derived statement', and certificate verification_boundary item 4]

The certified extra-source class is 'only ordinary homogeneous comoving radiation rho=C/a^4, p=rho/3, finite C>=0' (certificate scope.additional_sources; FORMULATION.md 'Hypotheses and source class'). The statement drops 'homogeneous comoving', the perfect-fluid form rho=C/a^4, and finiteness/nonnegativity of C, so its literal class also admits inhomogeneous or anisotropic traceless sources. The evidence certifies nothing about those: proof.md Section 4 computes E(T_rad)=C/a^4 only for the comoving homogeneous fluid, and scope.other_traceful_or_quantum_sources_included=false excludes only traceful/quantum sources, not wider traceless ones. [Statement phrase 'only additional ordinary traceless radiation' vs certificate scope.additional_sources and notes/proof.md Section 4]

The certified hypotheses restrict couplings to 'finite constants; b,kappa>0; ell,alpha,beta arbitrary' (certificate scope.couplings; FORMULATION.md: 'finite constants b>0, kappa>0'). These positivity scope words are absent from the statement. Under the statement's literal coupling class, the degenerate choice b=ell=alpha=beta=kappa=0 turns the displayed equation 'b*G_FK+ell*g_FK+alpha*I+beta*J=-kappa*(T_omega+T_rad)' into 0=0, satisfied by every admitted state, against the clause 'so no admitted state solves that whole-patch ansatz'. kappa>0 is also load-bearing in proof.md Section 4's error polynomial term 'abs(ell)*A^4*eta^8/kappa'. Only the pinned FORMULATION.md rescues the intended class. [Statement phrase 'finite constant gravitational couplings' vs certificate scope.couplings and FORMULATION.md hypothesis line 'finite constants b>0, kappa>0, arbitrary finite ell,alpha,beta']

The certified O(eta^-6) quantity is the state-difference remainder (certificate field 'state_difference'; FORMULATION.md: 'the difference is O_(omega,x)(eta^(-6))'), while E_omega itself is O(eta^-8). Parsed as the full EED, the clause would contradict the adjacent limit clause (t^4*O(t^-3) tends to 0, not hbar/(5120*pi^2)); context forces the difference reading, but the phrase admits the wrong parse. [Statement phrase 'State-dependent EED is O(eta^-6)' vs certificate 'state_difference' field and FORMULATION.md 'Exact state-dependent remainder interface']

Independent spot re-derivations reproduce certificate values: EED=3*rho with p=5*rho/3 gives hbar/(5120*pi^2*t^4); A^4*eta^8=16*t^4 gives the 1/320 vs 1/5120 ratio; C=3*A^2*b/kappa matches the Friedmann density; excluded-fluid trace hbar/(3840*pi^2*t^4) and its conservation; point-split coefficients (p-1)(q-1); P(1/100)=1/10000; the enclosure [21662869/10^11, 2166287/10^10] straddles 1/(320*pi^2)-1/10000. The machine layer supports every identity the statement invokes, within the disclosed boundary. [PASS entry binary_hash vs p8a_asymptotics v1 stamp; certificate fields prior_A3_sha256, source_sha256, EED_scaling_and_SEE_derivation, state_specific_quantitative_residual_example]
